Name: Operating checking
Notes: Customer payments and financing payouts land here

Name: Accounts receivable
Notes: Invoices sent and not yet paid

Name: Financing payouts receivable
Notes: Optional. Financed jobs finished but not yet paid by the lending partner

Name: Truck stock
Notes: Parts bought and still on the vans. Count it at month end

Name: Warehouse stock
Notes: Optional. Equipment and parts held at the shop

Name: Vehicles
Notes: Owned vans and trucks, at cost

Name: Tools and equipment
Notes: Recovery machines, jetters, cameras

Name: Accumulated depreciation
Notes: Contra account; carries a credit balance

Name: Accounts payable
Notes: Supply house invoices not yet paid. Tie to each supply house statement

Name: Customer deposits
Notes: Deposits on jobs not yet done. Becomes revenue when the job is finished and invoiced

Name: Deferred maintenance revenue
Notes: Maintenance plan money not yet earned

Name: Sales tax payable
Notes: Tax collected where parts or labor are taxable. Rules differ by state and province

Name: Payroll liabilities
Notes: Withholdings and employer taxes, from the payroll report

Name: Business credit card
Notes: The payment from checking is a transfer, not an expense

Name: Vehicle loans
Notes: Split each payment between this line and interest expense

Name: Service and repair revenue
Notes: Service calls, diagnostics, repairs

Name: Installation revenue
Notes: Equipment replacements and new installs, at full price even when financed

Name: Maintenance agreement revenue
Notes: The part of each plan earned this month

Name: Materials and equipment
Notes: Parts and units used on jobs

Name: Technician wages
Notes: Field labor, from the payroll report

Name: Callbacks and warranty work
Notes: Parts and labor on returns with no new invoice

Name: Permits
Notes: Job permits and inspections

Name: Office wages
Notes: Dispatch, office and sales staff

Name: Payroll taxes
Notes: Employer share from the payroll report

Name: Financing fees
Notes: Dealer fees taken by lending partners

Name: Merchant fees
Notes: Card processor fees

Name: Vehicle expense
Notes: Fuel, leases, repairs, insurance on the vans

Name: Rent
Notes: Shop and warehouse

Name: Insurance
Notes: General liability and workers' compensation

Name: Interest expense
Notes: Interest part of vehicle loan payments
